name: Moritsunekomon
source:
Naginata adviser, 32 years old, and single. He is also the homeroom teacher for Yanagawa and Kosumi's class. His subject is classic literature. He has a sloppy personality, but he keeps an eye on Yanagawa and Kosumi from a distance.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
